Which AI models and tools do you use?

Whatever fits your data and your rules. Low-sensitivity work can use leading commercial models under enterprise terms; sensitive work can run on models inside your own environment. You are not locked into our choices.

How do we know it worked?
We agree a baseline and two or three measures before we start, such as hours spent on a task or review effort, and we report against them. Attendance is not an outcome.
